name: claude-ichiba
description: Claude Code plugins by Gwenneg Lepage

plugins.name: ai-mentor
plugins.description: Describe your engineering problem, get the right AI workflow. Ranked, verified recommendations with ready-to-paste prompts that teach you why each approach works — not just how.

plugins.name: soundings
plugins.description: Take soundings before you ship. Point it at one or more GitHub/GitLab compare URLs and get a clear release verdict - release, manual review, or no-go - computed from the severities of the risks found and citing each risk that drove it, plus a report specific enough to act on: named files and functions, concrete pre-release checks, and compound-risk detection across repositories in multi-service deployments. No external LLM API, no service-account key, no Docker image - the Claude agent already in your session does the analysis in an isolated read-only stage hardened against prompt injection, a small Go helper does the fetching, and a normal run needs no permission prompts.

plugins.name: soundings-app-interface
plugins.description: Take soundings before you ship an app-interface deployment. Point it at a Red Hat app-interface MR and it resolves the compare URLs from the newest devtools-bot Diffs comment, runs one soundings analysis across all of them together - one clear release verdict, with compound risks across repositories caught - annotates the report with app-interface's override-justification and feedback conventions, and offers to post it back to the MR as a new comment under your own identity. Red Hat internal: requires the soundings plugin (0.6.0 or later), a GITLAB_TOKEN for the app-interface GitLab host, and VPN access.

plugins.name: togi
plugins.description: Captures AI coding friction — corrections, clarifications, denied tool calls — in-session at no extra cost, and turns recurring doc gaps into context-doc pull requests.
